answers.question: I mentioned an investment for a competition four weeks ago? What did I buy?
answers.gold: I got my own set of sculpting tools.
lines: [2023-01-25] User: I was thinking of using some of the money I made from selling my yarn stash online to buy some storage bins and containers to help with the organization. Do you think that's a good idea?

[2023-01-20] User: Wait, I think I remember my friend saying something about it being a special deal or something. Maybe it's a discounted ticket or a package deal with the hotel? Do you think that could be the case?

[2023-01-25] User: Yeah, the yarn stash sale has been going well. I used a combination of online marketplaces and social media to sell some of my rare and exotic yarns.
